item.title: Florida Georgia Line Signs With CAA
item.description:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, where we keep you in the loop with the latest music news. Today, we're talking about the country duo that's making waves once again - Florida Georgia Line.
[Short audio clip of "Cruise" plays]
Host: "Composed of Brian Kelley and Tyler Hubbard, the duo is known for smash hits like 'This Is How We Roll' and, of course, the RIAA Diamond-certified hit 'Cruise'. After taking a hiatus starting in 2022, they recently reunited onstage at CMA Fest, surprising fans with a performance at Nissan Stadium and a full set at Spotify House.
[Audio clip of Tyler Hubbard's quote: "And listen, we got three things we want to say tonight. First of all, God is good. Second of all, life is short. And most importantly, your boys … we back, baby!"]
Host: "That's right, folks - they're back! With 16 No. 1 hits on Billboard's Country Airplay chart and six No. 1 hits on the Hot Country Songs chart, Florida Georgia Line is a force to be reckoned with. And now, they've just signed with booking agency CAA, following their recent management deal with The Core Entertainment.
[Short music transition]
Host: "While there's no word on new music just yet - their last album, Life Rolls On, was released in 2021 - this signing is a good sign that we might be seeing more live shows from the duo soon. We'll be keeping an eye on this, and we can't wait to see what's next for Florida Georgia Line.
[Music and host continue for another 2 seconds before fading out]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you on the next one!"
